verses.text: Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach tzin kol in b'a. Malajokab' b'ak'inh tzin a cha somchajeli. Kolinel yuj a tojolal.
Ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin t'ayin, tzin a kolan t'a elanhchamel. Ochanh in nhak'eenok b'aj ol in kol in b'a.
Yujto in nhak'een ach, in cuartel ach, yuj chi' ochanh wenhulok. Ik' in b'eyok yik manh ol ach alchaj chukal.
Kolin t'a jun yaal ix em t'a wichanh, yujto in Kolumal ach.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, swak'kanoch in b'a t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha ach tzin a kolkaneli, to tz'elk'och syal a lolonel.
Tzin chakel heb' anima syak'em sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi. Ha inxo Mamin Jehová, tzach wak'och yipok in k'ool.
Tzin tzalaj wal yuj a wach'k'olal. Ha ach ix ik'el in kusk'olal, ojtak pax in yaelal.
Maj in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'ool. Te lewan b'aj ix in kan uuj.
Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' wal a k'ool t'ayin, yujto ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Ix te chakb'i in sat wok'i, manhxalaj yip in pixan yet' in niwanil.
Ha in k 'inal slajwiem t'a skal in yaelal. Ha wab'ilal slajwiel yuj in k'akwi. Ha kusk'olal tz'ik'anel wip, k'ununi yel yip in niwanil tik swab'i.
Tzetzab'il in yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, b'uchb'il in yuj heb' kajan t'a in lak'anil. Yajb'il in kanel yuj heb' ojtannak in. Ha heb' tzin ilan t'a yoltak b'e, tz'el heb' t'ayin.
Junelnhej ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'. Icha wal to manhxo in animaok swab'i, icha wal junok lum xalu pojnak, icha chi' waji.
Swab' sajson heb' wetchonhab' t'a in patik. Yalxonhej b'ajtiil, ay xiwk'olal sja t'ayin. Junlajanxonhej snaan heb' t'a in patik. Nanon yek' sk'ool heb' tas syutej in yak'anchamok.
Ha inxo jun Mamin Jehová, a achnhej ayachoch yipok in k'ool. Toxonton swala': Ha ach wal tik, in Diosal ach, xin chi.
Yol wal a k'ab' ay in k 'inal. Kolinel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' tzak'anoch wuuj.
Il in wal och a in a chekab' in tik yuj swach'il a k'ool, tzin a kolanel yuj a wach'k'olal.
Mamin, wan walan in b'a t'ayach. Manh in ak'b'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal. Ha heb' chuk tzak'kanb'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal chi', tzak'ankanb'at heb' b'aj tzinan, b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Ha heb' snaank'e lolonel, numk'ajokab' heb', yujto syal lolonel heb' ya t'a heb' anima wach'. Spatikejel heb' wach' spensar heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' wach' chi'.
Yel ton wal niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'a heb' tzach ik'anchaanh. T'a yichanh heb' anima tzak' a wach'ilal t'a heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'ool.
Ha t'a a tz'ey tza k'ub'ejel heb' t'a chukal sna heb' puch winak. Ha b'aj ay ach tza kolel heb' t'a schukal lolonel heb' ajk'olal yajoch t'a heb'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach Mamin Jehová, yujto satub'tak tas ix a b'o t'ayin yuj a wach'k'olal, ayik oyanoch heb' ajk'ool t'a in patik wichanh.
Ha wal yik manhxo animaok in k'ool, ix in na' to ix in ik'kanel t'a ichanh, haxo wal yik ix in k'anan a kolwal, ix ab' in tewi.
Xajanejek Jehová, masanil ex yikexxo yujto ha' stanhwan heb' sk'anab'ajani, palta tz'akan syutej yak'an yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' syik'chaanh sb'a.
Tek'b'ejek he b'a mach ex tzeyak'och Jehová yipok he k'ool.
